cues.en: In the last lecture, we added some configuration settings related to our cookie based authentication, and we had mentioned that you're going to have three cookies.
cues.zh: 上一堂課加入 Cookie 驗證相關設定，也提到會有三種 Cookie。

cues.en: That is the access token, the refresh token and the login token.
cues.zh: 分別是存取權杖、更新權杖，以及登入狀態 Cookie。

cues.en: So this access token is going to be short lived and will be used for API authentication.
cues.zh: 存取權杖有效期間較短，用於 API 身分驗證。

cues.en: The refresh token is going to be long lived and is going to be used to get new access tokens.
cues.zh: 更新權杖有效期間較長，用來取得新的存取權杖。

cues.en: And then this login token is not going to hold any sensitive data, it's just going to be used to help the front end or if the user is logged in or not.
cues.zh: 登入狀態 Cookie 不存敏感資料，只用來讓前端知道使用者是否已登入。

cues.en: This login token is going to be useful if we are ever to create a front end with any of the popular front end frameworks such as Next.js, Vue.js, angular, amongst others.
cues.zh: 如果之後用 Next.js、Vue.js、Angular 等熱門框架建立前端，它就會派上用場。
